scheduledPosts.title: Scheduled posts
scheduledPosts.description: Posts are published automatically at their scheduled time. Posts that could not be published (for example, more than 24 hours late) stay here so you can edit and reschedule, publish now, or delete them.
scheduledPosts.empty: No scheduled posts. Use 🕒 in the composer to schedule one.
scheduledPosts.publishConfirmBody: This will publish the post now instead of waiting for the scheduled time.
scheduledPosts.deleteConfirmBody: This post will be discarded without being published.
